prompt: A frame from a feature film set in the 1920s, shot on grainy 35mm colour film, the picture filling the frame edge to edge. The picture contains itself: the lit window of the top-floor attic shows this same scene again, smaller, and inside it again, smaller and smaller, spiralling inwards. One single tall tenement building cut open like a doll's house at night, seen from across a snowy street: at the bottom a blazing furnace and a gold-lit speakeasy with a band and gangsters dancing among money, each floor above colder and darker, and at the top an icy attic where an old woman sits at a candle. Snow falling; one lamp per floor fading upwards. Thanks.
